---
title: "Stock assessments"
---

How many of the stocks ICES gives advice on have their assessment in TAF, linked to the advice.

A stock counts as implemented in TAF for a year when it has a repository in [ices-advice](https://github.com/ices-advice) for that year, and the matching `_assessment` repository in [ices-taf](https://github.com/ices-taf) contains a `model.R` script. The number of stocks, their expert group and data category come from the [ICES Stock Database](https://sd.ices.dk).

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_plot.R")

stocks <- read.csv("../_generated/stocks-by-year.csv")
stocks$category <- factor(stocks$category, c("Category 1", "Categories 2-6"))
stocks <- stocks[order(stocks$year, stocks$category), ]

# the years since the first with an assessment implemented in TAF
years <- sort(unique(stocks$year))
years <- years[years >= min(stocks$year[stocks$taf > 0])]
stocks <- stocks[stocks$year %in% years, ]

# as in the dashboard: show last year's assessments until August
today <- as.POSIXlt(Sys.Date())
start <- today$year + 1900 - (today$mon < 7)
if (!start %in% years) start <- max(years)
```

## Stocks implemented in TAF

Choose the year with the menu above the chart.

```{r}
#| echo: false
p <- plot_ly()
for (year in years) {
  p <- p |>
    add_bars(
      data = stocks[stocks$year == year, ],
      x = ~category, y = ~stocks,
      name = "Stocks", marker = list(color = blue), visible = year == start,
      hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y} stocks<extra></extra>"
    ) |>
    add_bars(
      data = stocks[stocks$year == year, ],
      x = ~category, y = ~taf,
      name = "Stocks implemented in TAF", marker = list(color = orange), visible = year == start,
      hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y} implemented in TAF<extra></extra>"
    )
}

# one menu entry for each year, showing its two sets of bars
year_menu <- list(
  active = which(years == start) - 1,
  x = 1, xanchor = "right", y = 1.12, yanchor = "bottom",
  buttons = lapply(years, function(year) {
    list(
      method = "restyle", label = as.character(year),
      args = list("visible", as.list(rep(years == year, each = 2)))
    )
  })
)

p |>
  taf_layout(
    barmode = "group",
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "Count"),
    updatemenus = list(year_menu)
  )
```

## Stocks by expert group

The number of stocks implemented in TAF for each expert group, and the percentage of the group's stocks that is.

```{r}
#| echo: false
groups <- read.csv("../_generated/stocks-by-eg.csv")
groups <- groups[groups$year %in% years, ]
groups$cell <- sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", groups$n, groups$percent)

wide <- reshape(
  groups[c("eg", "year", "cell")],
  idvar = "eg", timevar = "year", direction = "wide"
)
names(wide) <- sub("^cell[.]", "", names(wide))
names(wide)[1] <- "Expert group"
wide <- wide[c("Expert group", as.character(sort(unique(groups$year))))]
wide[is.na(wide)] <- ""

# most covered in the latest year first
latest <- groups[groups$year == max(groups$year), ]
covered <- latest$percent[match(wide[[1]], latest$eg)]
wide <- wide[order(-ifelse(is.na(covered), -1, covered), wide[[1]]), ]

knitr::kable(wide, row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(wide) - 1)))
```

## Percentage of stocks with TAF assessments linked to advice

```{r}
#| echo: false
stocks$percent <- 100 * stocks$taf / stocks$stocks

plot_ly(
  stocks,
  x = ~year, y = ~percent, color = ~category, colors = c(blue, orange),
  type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
  line = list(width = 2), marker = list(size = 8),
  customdata = ~paste(taf, "of", stocks),
  hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y:.1f}% (%{customdata} stocks)"
) |>
  taf_layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "", dtick = 1),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Percentage of stocks", ticksuffix = "%",
      range = c(0, ceiling(max(stocks$percent) / 10) * 10 + 2)
    )
  )
```
